Chapter 10. Living in the Meantime: Embracing Life as It Is.
At some point, it just clicks... the meantime isn’t just something you’re supposed to hurry through. It’s actually a whole way of living—one where you show up for life as it is, right now.
Instead of waiting for some perfect moment, it's about being present with whatever comes your way, learning to trust the process, and finding meaning right in the middle of all the uncertainty.
Take the story of a woman who spent years waiting for the “right” relationship. One day, she realized that life was happening all around her—not on some distant horizon. So, she stopped putting her happiness on pause. She started saying yes—to new experiences, to deepening friendships, even to little adventures. Suddenly, the meantime was full of possibility, not just waiting.
You know, most of us don’t even notice how often we put off our own joy. We tell ourselves, “I’ll be happy when...” The meantime gently reminds us—life is always moving, even when it doesn't show up exactly how we pictured. Happiness isn’t something you find in the future. It’s something you can create, right here, right now.
There’s another story—about a man who always measured his worth by what he achieved. Over time, he learned to find real satisfaction in the smallest moments. Making breakfast. Calling a friend. Watching the sunset. The meantime taught him that meaning isn't just in the big wins, but in the way you show up for your own everyday life.
So, what does it really mean to live in the meantime? It’s about embracing uncertainty, trusting that you already have what you need, and staying open to whatever comes next. It’s letting go of the need to have everything resolved... and finding peace in the process itself.
As you keep moving forward, something shifts. The meantime stops being about waiting, and starts being about truly living. You begin to feel a new sense of freedom, a deeper connection to yourself and the people around you, and this quiet kind of joy—because you know, deep down, you are exactly where you need to be.
